description: This file defines the LogFragment class, which is a Fragment that contains a LogView to display log data in an Android application. It programmatically creates and configures the view hierarchy including a ScrollView and a custom LogView, and manages text change events to auto-scroll the log display.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass providing a user interface for displaying logs within a ScrollView, utilizing a custom LogView.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the View hierarchy, attaches a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when log content changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
